ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 5 — Annual Wellness Visit, Subsequent — Hubert H. Humphrey

text.paragraph: Subsequent annual wellness visit; no new complaints. [S]

Mr. Humphrey is a 66-year-old man with bladder cancer treated by radical cystoprostatectomy with an ileal conduit eight months ago, who returns for his subsequent annual wellness visit; his initial wellness visit was a year ago. He completed the health risk assessment beforehand. Since his last visit he has felt well. He takes sodium bicarbonate twice a day and his tiredness has improved. He drinks about 2 liters a day. The appliance seals well and he changes it every four days. He walks 30 minutes most days and works full time. The kidney infection in March cleared within two days of starting ciprofloxacin, with no recurrence. He has had no falls, emergency visits, or hospital stays since his operation. [S]

Voluntary advance care planning discussion of about 20 minutes, with his consent. He named a health care agent, and a health care proxy form was completed; the agent is recorded in the chart and is not named here. He said that what matters most to him is being able to keep working and to be with the people he cares about, and that he wants to be told plainly about his results. He chose not to record specific treatment preferences today. The plan will be revisited yearly and with any change in his health. [S]
